source: EDGAR, then one value changed by hand — see `planted` below

documents.date_basis: the latest filing whose facts this record contains; companyfacts is a catalogue of facts drawn from many filings and is not itself a filing

planted.what: one value, changed in a copy of tests/fixtures/CARR/companyfacts.json.gz so that a period comes back at a different number than the filing that first reported it
planted.one_document_only: this directory holds the copied companyfacts record and nothing else, and the manifest records exactly that. The filings themselves stay under tests/fixtures/CARR/, so a scan rooted here reports no absent filing: the absence of Carrier's July 2026 10-Q from companyfacts is judged against the committed record, where it is real.
